title: Anna's Food
text:
Anna likes breakfast. Every morning she eats bread with butter and drinks a glass of milk. Sometimes she eats an egg too.

At lunch, Anna eats rice and chicken. Her favorite fruit is an apple. After dinner, she drinks a cup of tea.

questions.text: What does Anna drink every morning?
What does Anna eat at lunch?
How does Anna probably feel about breakfast?
What can you guess about Anna's eating habits?
options: She eats only bread every day.
She eats many kinds of food.

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
a soft yellow food made from milk, eaten on bread
the one that you like best
the main meal of the day, eaten in the evening

paragraph_translations: A Anna gosta do café da manhã. Todas as manhãs ela come pão com manteiga e bebe um copo de leite. Às vezes ela também come um ovo.
No almoço, a Anna come arroz e frango. A fruta favorita dela é a maçã. Depois do jantar, ela bebe uma xícara de chá.
